page.notes: Marks along the left edge of the scan are edge damage or show-through from the reverse, not printed text, and are left out. "Edinburgę" is doubtful: the final letters are unclear. Italic is inferred from the scan for the proper names. The printed hyphens at line ends are kept as printed ("vigilia-tum", "stipendio-rum", "ex-tra", "arcef-fitur", "ip-sius", "praestitu-ros", "iis-demque", "comprehen-deret", "trans-Grampianas", "Co-"). The running head year "1640." is treated as part of the head.
